# Documentation change note

Use this optional note when describing a change limited to project prose.

- Base and head commits:
- Documentation paths changed:
- Formatting, links or examples checked:
- Result reported by the required CI check:
- Any remaining limitations:

The docs-only result means application/browser checks were not required; it does
not claim those tests executed. Agent instructions, governance and security
runbooks, and documentation in template/fixture folders use this same route.
A change that also edits application code, workflows or configuration keeps the
applicable full CI checks. See [documentation policy](../review-automation.md).
